description: Project Plan 365 lets you work with Microsoft Project (MS Project) and MPP files directly in ChatGPT. Create and manage project plans and Gantt chart schedules, open and analyze existing Microsoft Project MPP files, and review tasks, milestones, dates, durations, resources, assignments, dependencies, progress, and critical paths. Update project schedules using natural language, then download the updated MPP file or open it in Project Plan 365. Simplify project planning and project management while keeping your plans compatible with the Microsoft Project MPP file format.
